purpose: Machine-readable perimeter classification for every Edge Function deployed with verify_jwt = false. A function may appear in supabase/config.toml with verify_jwt = false only if it is listed here with an explicit, implemented perimeter. scripts/check-jwt-off-perimeter.mjs fails when the two lists diverge.

unsubscribe-contact.mechanism: contacts.unsubscribe_token lookup, minimum length 16; unknown token returns 404
unsubscribe-contact.writes: suppression fields on the matched contact only
unsubscribe-contact.rationale: one-click unsubscribe must work from an email client with no session

compliance-approve.mechanism: Bearer JWT + user_roles founder check in-function
compliance-approve.rationale: founder-only despite verify_jwt = false; validated in code

outreach-inbound-webhook.mechanism: x-webhook-secret === OUTREACH_WEBHOOK_SECRET, fail closed when unset
outreach-inbound-webhook.rationale: inbound mail relay cannot hold a Supabase session

autopilot-orchestrator.mechanism: x-cron-secret === CRON_SECRET, else Bearer JWT + user_roles check
autopilot-orchestrator.rationale: runs headless on a schedule and manually by the founder

smartlead-webhook.mechanism: x-smartlead-signature verified against SMARTLEAD_WEBHOOK_SECRET; receiver disabled when the secret is unset
smartlead-webhook.writes: smartlead event tables, contact suppression state

customer-voice-inbound-webhook.mechanism: x-voice-webhook-secret === CUSTOMER_VOICE_WEBHOOK_SECRET via authenticateVoiceCaller; fail closed when unset
customer-voice-inbound-webhook.stage_1_note: previously accepted any anonymous caller and wrote call logs

pr-gmail-oauth-callback.mechanism: HMAC-signed state parameter validated before the code exchange
pr-gmail-oauth-callback.rationale: OAuth redirect target cannot carry a Supabase session

social-distribution-dispatch-due.mechanism: requireFounderOrScheduler — x-dispatch-secret === SOCIAL_DISPATCH_SECRET, else founder/admin JWT

social-distribution-maintenance.mechanism: requireScheduler — x-dispatch-secret only, founder token NOT accepted
